thread:
anya (PM): Quick sync — we need a low-friction cutover runbook for next week's geo routing change. Scope: roll model-v2 (quant) behind flags. Primary goals: minimize user impact, detect quality regressions quickly, and have a <30s kill path.

jess (Product): +1. Proposed cadence: 5% canary (EU, 24h), then 25% (EU+APAC, 12h), then staged ramp to 100% pending signoffs. Metrics to gate: p95 latency, token cost delta, user error rate, and quality delta on our P0 prompt set.

sam (Eng): I'll own the orchestration and feature-flag plumbing. Need exact flag names and the API snippet we'll use for toggles. Also want automated rollback hook wired to alerts.

jess (Product): Flag pattern suggestion: route:model-v2:region:<region_code>. Example snippet for ops: 
```
# toggle example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/flags/toggle \\\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \\\
  -d '{"flag":"route:model-v2:region:eu","percent":5}'
```

marc (SRE): Circuit-breaker rules: trigger full rollback if (a) p95 latency increases by >300ms vs baseline for 30m, OR (b) user-visible errors >0.5% for 15m, OR (c) quality regression on P0 > threshold. Alert targets: #prod-alerts + page oncall. Fallback must be automatic to model-v1.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% EU -> model-v2 (quant). Canary run id: canary-2026-03-eu-1.

anya (PM): A/B evaluation plan: shadow-sample 1k live prompts (P0 suite + random corpus). Compare quality via our eval harness (BLEU/semantic-match + human spot-check). Need a named quality owner and a dashboard.

jess (Product): We'll use eval-suite `canary-v2-smoke` and run drift + regression diffs. Data team to own the dashboard and pass/fail logic.

sam (Eng): @lina (Data) can you own drift checks and the pass/fail dashboard? Also plan: pre-seed prefix cache with top 1k prefixes before increasing traffic.

lina (Data): lina (Data): I can own it. I'll build a synthetic vs live diff dashboard and set an automated flag to mark canary as 'needs human review' if regression > 2% on our signal. ETA: dashboard by EOD today.

marc (SRE): Quick-kill CLI (tested in staging):
```
# rollback to model-v1
redwood ctl route rollback --flag "route:model-v2:region:eu" --to "model-v1" --reason "canary-fail"
```
This triggers immediate traffic switch and notifies #prod-alerts.

anya (PM): Rollout gating checklist (pre-roll and during-roll):
- telemetry dashboard live + alerts configured
- quick-kill tested in staging + runbook link available
- canary eval results pipeline wired to dataset (P0)
- prefix cache pre-seed done
- customer opt-outs documented and respected
- security/reg compliance check for EU logs (no cross-region log export)
- ops on-call & product signoff for 25% -> 100%
Let's meet 9:00am PST tomorrow to sign off.

jess (Product): Note: for private deployments, ensure KMS/local logs don't leak to central analytics during the canary. If any tenant is on private, skip auto-ramp until confirmation.

sam (Eng): I'll add a traffic-sculpt policy to the balancer that slices by region+tenant tag and respects opt-outs. Also adding a delayed auto-increase: 25% -> 100% requires manual approval after 2 stable windows.

marc (SRE): Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/geo-cutover-low-friction (contains play-by-play, alert thresholds, escalation matrix). I'll create the alert run and test paging now.

anya (PM): Final Q: time-to-kill target is <30s from alert to switch. Ops please validate end-to-end in staging. If everyone is green, we'll start the 5% tomorrow at 10am UTC.

jess (Product): acked. Adding a sticky note in the release ticket with these guardrails and who signs the manual lift.

sam (Eng): tagging ticket: RFC-5092-cutover. Will attach the flag toggle script and rollback test logs.

marc (SRE): Ran a simulated failover in staging — time-to-kill measured at ~18s. Good to go pending final signoff.

deploy-bot: Canary completed (24h): metrics summary -> p95 latency +12ms, error rate +0.02%, quality delta on P0: -0.3% (within threshold). Awaiting decision to move to 25%.

anya (PM): Thanks all — we'll review the dashboard at the 9am PST signoff and decide on 25% ramp. If anyone spots a missed corner, call it out here. :thumbsup:
